title: Valuation Separation for Coprime Lucas Products
summary: Let $U_n=U_n(P,Q)$ be a nondegenerate Lucas sequence with $Q=\pm 1$ and discriminant $Δ=P^2+4Q>0$. We study Diophantine equations \[ A y^k=\prod_{i=1}^r U_{n_i}(P,Q), \qquad k\geq 2, \] where the indices $n_1,\ldots,n_r$ are pairwise coprime. The strong divisibility property implies that the factors $U_{n_i}$ are pairwise coprime, and hence a global $k$-th power condition separates into local valuation conditions on the individual factors.
